title: Roasted Chicken Casserole
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired roasted chicken casserole made with mildly spiced ingredients. A perfect comfort food for a chilly evening.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and black pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken until browned on both sides, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add the diced bell peppers and cook until tender.
Add the garam masala and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the canned diced tomatoes and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Add the shredded cheese on top of the mixture.
Place the seared chicken on top of the cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
